prompt:
You are watching a volleyball match from a fixed camera.

This clip begins at {start} seconds into the match.

CRITICAL INSTRUCTION: There are other matches in progress in the distant background (at the top of the screen). Completely IGNORE them. Focus ONLY on the main match taking place on the large court that occupies the bottom 3/4 of the screen. IMPORTANT: The main match includes BOTH the near side and far side of the net, AND the serving areas behind both baselines. You must track players on both sides and not miss serves from behind the court.

Only report events during a LIVE RALLY. A rally starts with a serve and ends when a point is scored. Ignore all dead-time passing, bouncing, celebrations, and pre-match warm-ups. Explicitly ignore normal intermediate passes; only report a pass if it is a 'receive', 'dig', or a 'set' that directly leads to a kill.

For each event give:
  t       - the precise time the player physically strikes the ball
  type    - must be one of:
            serve: the initial hit from behind the baseline that starts a rally
            receive: the first contact defending a serve
            dig: the first contact defending an attack
            set: an assist pass that directly leads to a kill
            attack: any hit sent over the net to the opponent's side that does not score a point
            kill: an attack that directly scores a point and ends the rally
            block: deflecting an attack at the net
  side    - "left" or "right": which side of the net the player is on (left half or right half of the screen)
  number  - the player's jersey number as a string, or null if you cannot read it
  error   - true if the touch was a mistake
  point   - true if the rally ended here and a point was scored
